summary: Battalion Oil Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $150M through agent Roth Capital Partners. Sales will be made under Rule 415(a)(4) with no fixed amount required; the company receives proceeds at market prices. Compensation to Roth is up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. This is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special event category. It is a standard capital markets transaction with no structural triggers or board recommendation beyond ordinary disclosure.
